inspector: B authoring agent, visual inspection of actual GLB round-trip renders; this is not human approval
findings: Inspected all eight native and four-times-nearest views, plus 22.5/67.5/157.5/292.5 degree headings and four quarter-turn wheel poses.
The red coupe identity and swept cabin are preserved. Separate glass ownership keeps aperture frames continuous and avoids glass leaking onto the body.
Hood seams, red ramps, restrained glass bands, side intake and three deck slats come from the embedded atlas; no post-render interior drawing is used.
Wheel pockets are real open geometry. Alpha outlines can merge far-side wheel/mirror details at native size, but no obvious tire/body clipping or stray texture-island colors were observed.
Source landmark rails and end trim improve mean eight-view silhouette IoU from roughly 0.950 in v1 to 0.962 in v4, but do not close the source-reduced route's silhouette lead.
remainingLimitations: Hood seams are heavier than the chosen approach-3 drawings; this is authored atlas width, not an outline-pass artifact.

The coachwork remains more angular and the body highlight layout more regular than the target or source-reduced route. Source landmarks are retained but this is an economical analytic retopology rather than the high-detail sculpt.
Some far-side trim and narrow deck/window details merge or change pixel coverage between headings. Three slats exist in the atlas but exact per-view line coverage is not guaranteed.
The four-times wireframe sheet is a coarse optional proof render and undersamples thin edges; exact exported topology statistics come from GLB indices and attributes.
